#!/bin/sh
# Copies notes/*.txt into backup/ and prints how many were copied.
mkdir -p backup
count=0
for f in notes/*.txt; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  cp "$f" backup/
  count=$((count + 1))
done
echo "copied $count files"

args.command: rm -rf backup && sh backup.sh && ls backup
